name: How can I redesign my kitchen layout when my budget is tight?

mainEntity.name: How can I redesign my kitchen layout when my budget is tight?

acceptedAnswer.text: A limited budget does not require keeping a poor layout, but it makes priorities essential. Preserve plumbing and major appliance locations where possible, focus on the most disruptive bottleneck, and spend first on storage, preparation space, lighting, and durable high-use components. Cosmetic changes can be phased after functional work is complete. Ask for at least one lower-scope alternative so you can compare savings with lost functionality. Elite Remodeling & Design can evaluate a layout as part of a remodeling plan that includes design, construction, and material decisions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Keep major utility locations where practical, solve the worst functional problem first, and prioritize storage, preparation space, lighting, and durable high-use components. Compare a same-footprint plan with a larger reconfiguration, then phase cosmetic upgrades if needed.
